surfaces.asserts: that the Board endpoint exists and answers, for every copy of Riplox 1.7.0 and later
surfaces.note: Shipping the app is a permanent promise to keep this endpoint alive: winget, Scoop, Chocolatey and GitHub copies will call it for years.
